name: gui_model_from_file
description: MI-1s, from Blank with the GUI only (engine MI-1). File > New Project > Blank; a Forward opaque material pass read by present (add_primitive_object's path), with nothing to draw yet. A .glb outside the project (gui_model_from_file.prepare.py copies the material pass scenario's checker box into incoming/): Add Object > Model from file... and its path typed into Qt's file dialog. Studio copies it into assets/models, sends register_model with the path alone (the engine names it by the file's stem, live), and spawns an object drawing it, named after the model, as Add Object > Cube does. The Outliner and the Inspector show it, list_assets lists it, and the middle of the viewport is no longer the background. Saved, another project opened and this one again: the engine that starts on it loads the model and the object, and draws it.
